name: @keel-engine/worldgen
description: World generation: climate and biomes (data, packs add their own), biome swapping (re-skin, seasons, runtime spread), the infinite chunked overworld (rivers, lakes, structures, ores, caves), action-RPG dungeons (BSP, room grammar, cellular caves, drunkard walks, wave function collapse), foliage scatter, and composable generator pipelines stored as codec recipes.
